ja: コミックボンボンで好評連載中の「SD頑駄無　武者○伝2」に登場する大将軍を守る史上最強の親衛隊である「號號将頑駄無」のプラモデル。スライドギミックで「通常形態」から「武者形態」へさらに「叛多亜武者形態」へ変形できます。武器は刀、大型ボーガンを装備可能です。
en: A plastic model of the strongest bodyguard in history, "Gogoshou Gundam", which protects the great general, which appears in "SD Gundam Musha○den 2", which is currently being serialized in Comic Bonbon. With the slide gimmick, it can be transformed from "normal form" to "musha form" and further to "Rita sub-musha form". Weapons can be equipped with a sword or a large bowgun.
